values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/mudlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Mud Lake State Forest Campground, Clare: 8 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in boat launch on the south side of the campground.

note: Secluded rustic state forest campground on the shore of Mud Lake (Clare County), 11 mi E of Evart via US-10, M-66, 7 Mile Road and Brown Road. Direct access to the Green Pine Lake Pathway on the east side. Managed by Wilson State Park. --Claude
